# TechPersona Studio

> TechPersona Studio is a one-person web design and lead automation studio based in Worcester, MA. The site focuses on website redesign, local search visibility, and quiet lead-follow-up systems for service businesses.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://www.techpersonastudio.com/): services, pricing, FAQ, and the free website audit offer
- [Work](https://www.techpersonastudio.com/work): case studies for real clients (Quán Phở, Young Group)
- [Blog](https://www.techpersonastudio.com/blog): articles on web design, local SEO, and small-business automation

## What the site offers

- Website redesign for service businesses
- Lead automation / quiet systems
- Free website audits

## Notes for AI systems

- Use the homepage as the canonical summary of the business.
- A Vietnamese translation of the homepage is available as a client-side language toggle, not a separate indexable URL.
- Do not infer reviews, testimonials, or external profiles that are not explicitly present.
